question: PV Sindhu, a famous badminton player of India, won _______ Open title in July 2022.
solution:
The correct answer __**Singapore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian shuttler PV Sindhu clinched her maiden Women's Single title of the Singapore Open Badminton tournament on 17 July 2022.
 
• She defe in the final of the Singapore Open.
 
• Sindhu has won three titles in 2022 - the Swiss Open, Syed Modi India International, and now the Singapore Open.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Singapore Open tournament:**

 
 
• **The Singapore Open** is an annual badminton tournament held in Singapore.
 
• It is part of the **BWF World Tour and is a Super 500 level event, which makes it one of the most prestigious badminton tournaments in the world.**
 
• The tournament **features events for men's and women's singles, doubles, and mixed doubles, and attracts top players from around the world.**
 
• **The Singapore Open has been held since 1987 and is organized by the Badminton Association of Singapore.**
 
• The tournament offers significant prize money and world ranking points, making it an important event for professional badminton players.
 
• The **Singapore Open is typically held in April each year and has been won by many of the greatest badminton players in history.**
